quests.instruction: Which word means you and your siblings, but seen from your grandparents' point of view?
quests.hint: The same group of kids gets a different name depending on who is speaking.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren means you and your siblings, but seen from your grandparents' point of view.
quests.funFact: The very same child can be called a son, a grandchild, and a nephew, all by different relatives!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the children in a family who are all the same generation?
quests.hint: This group does not include parents or grandparents.
quests.explanation: Siblings describes the children in a family who are all the same generation.
quests.funFact: Siblings are usually the people who know your family's inside jokes best!

quests.instruction: Which word describes all your relatives beyond your parents and siblings?
quests.hint: This word points to the wider circle beyond your own household.
quests.explanation: Extended Family describes all your relatives beyond your parents and siblings.
quests.funFact: The word 'extended' means stretched out further, just like this wider circle of relatives!

quests.instruction: Which word means the people you might send a holiday card to because they are family?
quests.hint: This includes family you might not see very often.
quests.explanation: Relatives means the people you might send a holiday card to because they are family.
quests.funFact: Sending cards or messages is a lovely way to stay in touch with relatives who live far away!

quests.instruction: Which word means your great-grandmother and great-grandfather together?
quests.hint: This word combines the two people from that even-older generation.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents means your great-grandmother and great-grandfather together.
quests.funFact: Since you can have up to four grandparents, you could have up to eight great-grandparents!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the group a grandmother or grandfather is proud to show off in photos?
quests.hint: Grandparents often carry pictures of this exact group in their wallet.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren describes the group a grandmother or grandfather is proud to show off in photos.
quests.funFact: Many grandparents keep a special photo wall or album just for pictures of their grandchildren!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe two brothers, two sisters, or one of each?
quests.hint: This word does not specify gender at all.
quests.explanation: Siblings could describe two brothers, two sisters, or one of each.
quests.funFact: Even a family with just two children still has siblings — as few as one brother or sister counts!

quests.instruction: Which word means aunts, uncles, cousins, and grandparents, considered as one group beyond your immediate household?
quests.hint: This word covers relatives outside your own home.
quests.explanation: Extended Family means aunts, uncles, cousins, and grandparents, considered as one group beyond your household.
quests.funFact: Extended family gatherings are a wonderful chance to see relatives you might not see every day!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the people you might invite to a big family celebration?
quests.hint: Think of everyone on your family tree who might come to a big party.
quests.explanation: Relatives describes the people you might invite to a big family celebration.
quests.funFact: Big celebrations like weddings often bring together relatives who have not seen each other in years!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the earliest generation many people ever get the chance to meet in person?
quests.hint: For many people, this is as far back as they can meet family in person.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents often describes the earliest generation many people ever get the chance to meet in person.
quests.funFact: Not everyone gets to meet a great-grandparent, which can make the connection extra special!

quests.instruction: Which word means the children who will one day inherit a grandparent's family stories?
quests.hint: These are the children a grandparent hopes will remember the family's history.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren means the children who will one day inherit a grandparent's family stories.
quests.funFact: Passing down family stories to grandchildren is a wonderful way to keep family history alive!

quests.instruction: Which word means all the children that belong to your own two parents?
quests.hint: This includes you and every brother or sister you have.
quests.explanation: Siblings means all the children that belong to your own two parents.
quests.funFact: Some cultures have special words for an older sibling versus a younger one, in addition to this general word!

quests.instruction: Which word means the wider circle of family beyond just the people in your own house?
quests.hint: This word describes relatives who live outside your household.
quests.explanation: Extended Family means the wider circle of family beyond just the people in your own house.
quests.funFact: In some cultures, extended family members live together in one big household!

quests.instruction: Which word describes people connected to you by family, whether close or distant?
quests.hint: This word can include people you see every week or only once a year.
quests.explanation: Relatives is the word for people connected to you by family, whether close or distant.
quests.funFact: The word 'relatives' comes from the idea of being 'related' to someone through family ties!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the oldest generation shown at the very top of many family trees?
quests.hint: This is usually the earliest generation many family trees include.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents often describes the oldest generation shown at the very top of many family trees.
quests.funFact: Some very detailed family trees go back even further than great-grandparents!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe a grandson, a granddaughter, or several of each?
quests.hint: This word works for any mix of boys and girls.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren could describe a grandson, a granddaughter, or several of each.
quests.funFact: A grandparent can have many grandchildren if each of their own children has kids too!

quests.instruction: Which word means the group made up of a mother and father's own children?
quests.hint: This word is about the children, not the parents.
quests.explanation: Siblings means the group made up of a mother and father's own children.
quests.funFact: The number of siblings someone has is often called their 'family size' among the children.

quests.instruction: Which word describes family members connected to you, but who live outside your own home?
quests.hint: These relatives are connected to you, just not under your own roof.
quests.explanation: Extended Family describes family members connected to you, but who live outside your own home.
quests.funFact: Some children see their extended family every week, while others see them only on special occasions!

quests.instruction: Which word means people who share your family history, even if they live far away?
quests.hint: Distance does not remove this kind of connection.
quests.explanation: Relatives means people who share your family history, even if they live far away.
quests.funFact: Many families stay connected with faraway relatives through video calls and letters!

quests.instruction: Which word means the people your own grandparents call 'Mom and Dad'?
quests.hint: Think of your grandparents' own parents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents means the people your own grandparents call 'Mom and Dad'.
quests.funFact: Your grandparents were once children being raised by their own parents, just like you!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the children of your own children?
quests.hint: This word is used from a grandparent's point of view.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren describes the children of your own children.
quests.funFact: Grandparents often say the word 'grandchildren' with a big, proud smile!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe just brothers, just sisters, or a mix of both?
quests.hint: This is a gender-neutral word for the sibling relationship.
quests.explanation: Siblings could describe just brothers, just sisters, or a mix of both.
quests.funFact: Some families have many siblings, while others have just one child with none at all!

quests.instruction: Which word means every relative outside of your mom, dad, and siblings?
quests.hint: This is the family circle beyond your own immediate household.
quests.explanation: Extended Family means every relative outside of your mom, dad, and siblings.
quests.funFact: Extended family can include people from both your mom's side and your dad's side of the family!

quests.instruction: Which word covers every person on your family tree, near or far?
quests.hint: This word applies no matter how far back or how far away the connection is.
quests.explanation: Relatives covers every person on your family tree, whether the connection is near or far.
quests.funFact: A really detailed family tree can sometimes take up an entire wall to display!

quests.instruction: Which word means the generation three steps above your own parents?
quests.hint: Count up: parents, grandparents, then one more step.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents means the generation three steps above your own parents.
quests.funFact: Each generation you count back on a family tree usually doubles the number of relatives!

quests.instruction: Which word means the generation two steps below your own parents?
quests.hint: Count down: parents, then their children.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren means the generation two steps below your own parents — that generation is you and your siblings.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, grandchildren are usually drawn two levels below their grandparents!

quests.instruction: Which word means children who share the same two parents?
quests.hint: This word describes the relationship, not just one gender.
quests.explanation: Siblings means children who share the same two parents.
quests.funFact: Twins are technically siblings too, just born on the very same day!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe the relatives who gather at a big family reunion?
quests.hint: Think of everyone beyond your own household who shows up to a big gathering.
quests.explanation: Extended Family could describe the relatives who gather at a big family reunion.
quests.funFact: Big family reunions sometimes bring together relatives who have never even met before!

quests.instruction: Which word means everyone in your family, from your parents to your second cousins?
quests.hint: This word stretches across your whole family tree.
quests.explanation: Relatives means everyone in your family, from your parents to your more distant cousins.
quests.funFact: You can have hundreds of relatives once you count great-aunts, second cousins, and more!

quests.instruction: Which word means the group of relatives even older than your grandparents?
quests.hint: This generation comes before your grandparents' own childhood.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents means the group of relatives even older than your grandparents.
quests.funFact: Some families are lucky enough to have four generations alive together at once!
